subject_line: An Author Spotlight for How to Write an Instant Bestseller
email_body:
Hi Robert,

Seeing How to Write an Instant Bestseller reach No. 1 on Amazon in Entrepreneurship, Marketing and Business Writing Skills caught my attention. Your focus on helping business authors turn a book into a platform for credibility and growth is a topic our readers care about, and building StoryReel Studios gives you a distinctive angle on it.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for How to Write an Instant Bestseller is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit How to Write an Instant Bestseller best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
